notes.title: Happy Easter
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers,
We're staging a competition.There 2 Easter in Interregnum.

Second one is a sentence from a person who famous.
Send us movie's and famous person's name on [url=https://www.instagram.com/lotusgamestr/]Instagram Direct[/url] .

Valid until July 7, 23:00 Istanbul time.Good Luck!
